title: Creamy Ravioli Bake
description: A comforting casserole of gooey cheese and homemade ravioli topped with a crispy golden crust.

ingredients.name: Homemade Ravioli
ingredients.notes: Make your own ravioli or use store-bought

ingredients.name: Roasted Cheese Sauce
ingredients.notes: Melted mozzarella and parmesan cheese with a hint of nutmeg

ingredients.name: Gooey Mozzarella Cheese
ingredients.notes: Optional for an extra gooey top layer

instructions: Cook ravioli according to package instructions.
In a separate saucepan, melt the roasted cheese sauce over low heat.
Add Italian seasoning and stir to combine.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of cooked ravioli.
Pour the cheese sauce over the ravioli, followed by a sprinkle of shredded mozzarella.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Optional: Add a layer of gooey mozzarella cheese on top and return to the oven for an additional 5-10 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
